case.short_input: Weak frontend resume vs Frontend Intern JD
case.expected: Low-to-mid score; flags missing TypeScript, testing, REST; rewrites vague bullets without inventing metrics

analysis.score_reason: The candidate has relevant React experience and some measurable impact, but lacks critical technical requirements like TypeScript, REST API integration, and unit testing frameworks specified in the JD.

missing_skills.jd_evidence: Experience with TypeScript in a real project
Familiarity with REST API integration and handling asynchronous state
Exposure to unit testing with Jest or a similar framework

weak_bullet_ids.original: Did a project on web development using HTML, CSS and some JavaScript.
weak_bullet_ids.problem: Vague description; lacks technical depth and specific outcomes.

weak_bullet_ids.original: Worked on the company website and fixed bugs.
weak_bullet_ids.problem: Lacks specific details on the nature of bugs or the impact of the work.
Extremely vague; does not specify testing methodologies or tools used.

red_flags: Objective statement is generic and adds no value to the resume.
Lack of technical depth in internship experience.
No mention of REST API or asynchronous state handling despite being a core requirement.

rewrites.original: Did a project on web development using HTML, CSS and some JavaScript.
rewrites.improved: Developed a web project utilizing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to implement interactive frontend components.
rewrites.why_better: Replaces the vague verb 'did' with 'developed' and clarifies the application of the technologies.

rewrites.original: Worked on the company website and fixed bugs.
rewrites.improved: Contributed to the company website codebase by identifying and resolving functional bugs to improve site stability.
rewrites.why_better: Uses professional terminology to describe the contribution and the outcome of the bug fixes.

rewrites.improved: Assisted the development team in performing quality assurance testing on company web assets.
rewrites.why_better: Provides a more professional description of the testing process without inventing specific methodologies not present in the resume.
